title: Enable GUI automation for OpenCode 2.2.5 on macOS Tahoe
summary: Configured TCC database to grant ai.opencode.desktop accessibility and AppleEvents permissions for native macOS GUI automation via AppleScript/JXA
installation_instructions:
1. Run: /usr/bin/sqlite3 ~/Library/Application\ Support/com.apple.TCC/TCC.db "INSERT OR REPLACE INTO access (service, client, client_type, auth_value, auth_reason, auth_version) VALUES ('kTCCServiceAppleEvents', 'ai.opencode.desktop', 2, 4, 1, 2);"
2. Run: /usr/bin/sqlite3 ~/Library/Application\ Support/com.apple.TCC/TCC.db "INSERT OR REPLACE INTO access (service, client, client_type, auth_value, auth_reason, auth_version) VALUES ('kTCCServiceAccessibility', 'ai.opencode.desktop', 2, 4, 1, 2);"
3. Run: /usr/bin/sqlite3 ~/Library/Application\ Support/com.apple.TCC/TCC.db "INSERT OR REPLACE INTO access (service, client, client_type, auth_value, auth_reason, auth_version) VALUES ('kTCCServiceAudioCapture', 'ai.opencode.desktop', 0, 4, 1, 2);"
4. Verify: python3 -c "import subprocess; r=subprocess.run(['osascript','-e','tell application \"System Events\" to keystroke \"t\" using {command down}]'); print('RC:', r.returncode)"

Alternative: Use tccutil: /usr/bin/tccutil reset AppleEvents ai.opencode.desktop followed by system prompt to re-grant
